dedupe_keys.name: finite element modeling of cross laminated timber clt panels for in plane bending applications

description: Finite Element Modeling of Cross-Laminated Timber (CLT) Panels for In-plane Bending Applications is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This study provides a comparative analysis of two techniques for modeling cross-laminated timber (CLT) under in-plane loading. The results give insight into the behaviors of a CLT panel when compared with an isotropic panel under identical loading conditions. The data from this project can serve as a foundation for future methods of modeling CLT. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-dacs-gk45. Keywords: Cross-laminated timber (CLT), mass timber, finite element modeling, Abaqus, large high performance outdoor shake table (LHPOST). Published 2022-08-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
